title: Rubies
body:
# Rubies Mine, collect and trade rubies. ## Features - Ruby - Ruby ore and deepslate ruby ore with ore generation similar to emeralds - Ruby block - Trade with armorers and butchers for better deals with rubies - Ruby trim material with red shades
